findings.three_d_policy: Keep world-3D as shadow/confidence-only evidence until spatial 3D ground truth is collected; do not fit 3D angles to these 2D labels.

manual_reference.angle_definition: A-B-C projected 2D angle in degrees; B is always the vertex

three_d_interpretation: Manual labels are projected 2D pixel angles. A world-3D difference is therefore a projection-consistency gap, not a direct 3D ground-truth error.
